name: Rude Slash
description: Lunge one long step forward and drop the belly onto the target as the lead heel lands.

name: Stern Hookbelly
description: Send a pulse of qi down the leading leg so the stride carries the hew a hand further.

name: Whumpcurl
description: Plant the front foot hard to stop a charge and hold the blade ready above the knee.

name: Stubborn Heavytip
description: Lift the spine into a descending cut and slide the foe's edge off toward the ground.

name: Waisttonic
description: Feel the rhythm of the opponent's footfalls through the soles and time the next lunge to it.

name: Swift Chip
description: Cover three paces in one qi-driven bound and bring the blade down before the target can guard.

name: Keen Inwardcurve
description: Hew once and follow the retreating target with a second step and a second hew without pause.

name: Emberchip
description: Seat the notch on the target's edge and chop down so the blade bites and cannot slip.

name: Waistslap
description: Hook the belly inside the opponent's elbow and pull to strip their reach.

name: Dense Chopmass
description: Take an incoming blade in the notch and stop it against the guard with a firm wrist.

name: Chipbuckle
description: Pull the hooked wrist toward the body so the opponent's weapon arm is carried off line.

name: Discord Bulgeedge
description: Twist the notch along a caught blade until the opponent's fingers open and the weapon falls.

name: Brawn Kinkspine
description: Pivot around a hooked arm so the user stands at the opponent's flank.

name: Entangling Notch
description: Catch a weapon in the notch and drag it down while qi hardens the belly for a follow-up chop.

name: Levering Horntang
description: Hook a leading leg and pull with a surge of qi until the opponent tumbles to the floor.

name: Ruthless Lopstroke
description: Chop down across a spear shaft where it meets the hand and bite into the wood.

name: Lithe Forwardbelly
description: Duck beneath a thrusting haft and slide forward along it to close the gap.

name: Kinkscreen
description: Turn the blade flat against a swinging staff and roll it wide of the body.

name: Lassoing Chip
description: Drive the notch over a spear shaft and lock it so the long weapon cannot be drawn back.

name: Keen Cho
description: Gather qi in the belly and hew through a staff or spear shaft in one heavy cut.

name: Wild Pommelcap
description: Ride a qi-eased slide along the long weapon and cut the gripping hand at its end.

name: Bold Pommelcap
description: Take the handle in both hands and bring the blade down with the full drop of the body.

name: Kinkslap
description: Turn the shoulders through the swing so a two-handed chop crosses the target at the ribs.

name: Forwardbelly Barrier
description: Brace the spine with the second hand and absorb a heavy chop on the flat of the blade.

name: Gritgash
description: Sink low over bent knees and rise forward into the next stroke with the weight behind it.

name: Lassoing Kinkspine
description: Shove the handle end into the opponent's chest to stop their advance and open space.

name: Lunarkink
description: Read from the load in both palms how much force the next hew still holds.

name: Savage Whump
description: Gather qi through both shoulders and bring a huge hew down that breaks a raised guard.

name: Rubble Whump
description: Swing a wide two-handed arc at waist height that forces every foe near to leap back.

name: Hookbelly Prop
description: Hold the blade high to take a strike then drop it straight down with the opponent's own force.

name: Brass Horntang
description: Chop at the opponent's forearm first to test their reach and draw a hurried guard.

name: Notchscorer
description: Hew from the side into the ribs just as the forearm drops to defend.

name: Dire Heavytip
description: Finish the ladder with an overhead drop to the shoulder while the guard is out of place.

name: Dense Bulgeedge
description: Beat aside a strike on a fixed count so the next chop begins without a pause.

name: Rill Slash
description: Step with the beat of the qi pulse so the body arrives as the blade falls.

name: Discord Gash
description: Tap the spine against the opponent's blade hand just as they begin to swing.

name: Waistcordial
description: Count the pulse of qi along the edge and note when it peaks for the best chop.

name: Rough Lopstroke
description: Release the stored qi at the peak of the pulse so the chop lands with doubled weight.

name: Gash Swat
description: Chain three hews on offset pulses so the target cannot find a rhythm to guard by.

name: Brass Inwardcurve
description: Sink qi into the stance and hold the blade across the body until the pressure of the attack fades.

name: Waistflog
description: Cut with the belly at a distance of one forearm where the long edge is hardest to avoid.

name: Lurching Hookbelly
description: Hook into the pocket of the opponent's elbow and yank it across their chest.

name: Unmoving Forwardbelly
description: Fold the arm tight and bring the spine across the ribs to turn a short strike.

name: Veering Cho
description: Shuffle sideways in a tight space while the blade stays close to the body.

name: Attentive Inwardcurve
description: Judge the opponent's reach by the angle of the shoulders and keep the belly at that distance.

name: Acrid Notch
description: Drop low and hook the belly through both knees with a surge of qi in the curve.

name: Choprop
description: Break a clinch with a jolt of qi through the handle and chop as the grip falls away.

name: Notchflog
description: Draw out of the sheath into a slash that carries across the target in one pull.

name: Kinkspine Scorer
description: Bring the blade back across the opponent's body from below as the first cut finishes.

name: Unmoving Cho
description: Reseat the blade at the hip in a guard that keeps the sheath hand covering the belly.

name: Rill Pommelcap
description: Turn on the heel after the cut and step back to the starting line.

name: Gallgash
description: Press the sheath hand against the opponent's wrist to stop their draw.

name: Horntang Poultice
description: Read the line the foe takes after a miss and fix the return cut to meet it.

name: Honed Chip
description: Let a wave of qi carry the blade back along its own arc into a second chop at once.

name: Rill Heavytip
description: Cut out to deflect a strike and return in the same breath to chop the opening it leaves.

name: Notchprop
description: Press the belly down across an opponent's blade and pin it to the ground.

name: Chipslap
description: Slide the kukri along the pinned blade toward the gripping fingers.

name: Gagging Chopmass
description: Step on the flat of a dropped weapon to hold it while the kukri rises.

name: Lithe Bulgeedge
description: Release the pin and step out of range before the opponent can counter.

name: Chipbarrier
description: Lock the crossed blades together with a steady flow of qi until the opponent cannot lift them.

name: Brutal Gash
description: Hold a pin and release it into one hard chop at the wrist as the opponent strains.
